## Current

```typescript
Current: EntityList | null;
```

The complete current-frame entity set. `Some(empty)` is known empty; `None` is unavailable
or incomplete. Filtering remains ordinary script code.

## All

Enumerate entities without an implicit count limit. Pass a limit only when partial results are intended.

## Monsters

```typescript
Monsters(range?: number | null, rarity?: MonsterRarity | number | null): EntityList;
```

Find alive, hostile, non-hidden monsters within the grid radius, filtered by rarity.
The default radius is 200 grid units; combine MonsterRarity flags with |. Use Take to limit the result count.

**@keywords**

monsters, enemies, radius, rarity, reagent
